display.purpose: Anchor statements only: the hero h1 and the contact close. Cabinet Grotesk 700, fluid clamp to 6.5rem, tracking -0.04em. One or two per view.

headline.purpose: Section headings (About, Selected work, Contact close). Cabinet Grotesk 700, fluid to 3.75rem, tracking -0.03em.

title.purpose: Project names in the work log; shift to amber on row hover. Cabinet Grotesk 700, fluid to 2.5rem, held a step below h2 at every viewport.

body.purpose: All prose and metadata: descriptions, roles, dates, status, stack tags, the email, eyebrow labels. IBM Plex Mono 400; lead paragraphs step up to 1.125rem. Body is mono now, not sans.

label.purpose: Instrument-badge eyebrows and small mono labels. IBM Plex Mono, 0.72rem, tracking 0.25em, uppercase.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No box-shadow anywhere. Depth is true-neutral tonal layering (canvas to panel to surface to elevated) plus 1px hairline borders. Shadows are forbidden as a depth device.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal entrances (opacity + 20px translateY, 0.6s), the hero word-by-word clip reveal (0.72s), and the self-drawing amber headline underline (0.55s).

motion.name: ease-deliberate
motion.purpose: Animated hairline underline on inline text links (scaleX 0 to 1, 0.3s).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus color and border shifts on buttons, links, inputs, nav. Snappy, no choreography.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: Top-bar nav link underline grows from 0 to full width on hover and for the active section.

components.name: Eyebrow Badge
components.description: Signature block opener (every section and the hero availability kicker): a sharp-cornered hairline badge that shrink-wraps a mono, uppercase, wide-tracked label, led by a 6px filled-amber square marker that reads as a functional status indicator, not decoration.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-eyebrow-marker { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #f59e0b; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-intent action (hero 'Selected work', contact 'Send message'). White fill on dark text, warming to amber on hover. Sharp corners.
components.html: Selected work
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #f5f5f5; color: #0a0a0a; border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f59e0b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Non-primary CTAs (hero 'Get in touch', top-bar 'Email', 'Send another'). Transparent with a strong hairline border; text and border warm to amber on hover. Sharp corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a3a3a3; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: #f59e0b; border-color: #f59e0b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-bar section link, mono uppercase, with an amber underline that grows from 0 to full width on hover and stays full for the active section (also drives aria-current).
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a3a3a3; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -4px; height: 1px; width: 0; background: #f59e0b; transition: width 200ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f5f5f5; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="true"] { color: #f5f5f5; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="true"]::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stack Chip
components.description: Quiet informational tech-stack tag in the work log. Sharp-cornered hairline box, mono uppercase muted text. No interactive state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a8a; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Contact-form text input: transparent with a strong hairline border that turns amber on focus; mono label above. Error state swaps the border to danger and shows an AlertTriangle-led helper so the signal never rests on color alone.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a8a; } .ds-req { color: #f59e0b; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #404040; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 1rem; color: #f5f5f5; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #525252; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #f59e0b; outline: none; }

components.name: Work Entry Row
components.description: Signature project log row: a two-column grid (meta 5 / media 7) separated from its neighbours by a top hairline. Mono period, Cabinet Grotesk title that shifts to amber on row hover, tagline, description, a Role/Status mono key-value stack, hairline stack chips, and amber hairline-underline links. No numeric index. Deliberately not a card.

components.css: .ds-work { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; border-top: 1px solid #262626; padding: 48px 0; } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-work { grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr; gap: 40px; } } .ds-work-period { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a8a; } .ds-work-title { margin: 16px 0 0; font-family: 'Cabinet Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #f5f5f5; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-work:hover .ds-work-title { color: #f59e0b; } .ds-work-tag { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-work-kv { margin: 20px 0 0; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-work-kv div { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-work-kv dt { color: #8a8a8a; } .ds-work-kv dd { margin: 0; color: #a3a3a3; } .ds-work-link { display: inline-block; margin-top: 20px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f59e0b; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: border-color 300ms; } .ds-work-link:hover { border-color: #f59e0b; } .ds-work-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border: 1px solid #262626; background: #0d0d0d; }

components.name: Spec Panel
components.description: Honest stand-in for a project with no public demo (e.g. an app behind SSO): a 16:10 panel with a faint technical grid, an amber hairline, and a mono 'Walkthrough on request' label. Used instead of a screenshot rather than faking one.
components.html: Walkthrough on request
components.css: .ds-spec { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border: 1px solid #262626; background: #0d0d0d; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px; } .ds-spec-rule { width: 32px; height: 1px; background: #f59e0b; } .ds-spec-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a8a; }

narrative.overview: A precise, honest record rebuilt in a bold neo-brutalist Swiss key: a true-neutral graphite canvas, structure drawn in 1px hairlines instead of boxes, sharp corners everywhere, and a single warm signal (amber #f59e0b) that appears only where it means something. Metadata and prose alike are set in IBM Plex Mono and read like log entries; the few statements that anchor a section are set large in Cabinet Grotesk. Project work is listed as logbook rows, never packaged into glossy cards, and is no longer numbered. The personality is precise, understated, and honest; the emotional target is quietly impressive. It earns trust by not trying too hard, and every detail holds up under inspection, because the people reading this screen-by-screen are exactly the people who inspect details.
keyCharacteristics: True-neutral graphite canvas with stepped tonal surfaces (#0a0a0a to #0d0d0d to #171717 to #1f1f1f); depth from layering and 1px hairlines, never shadows.
One warm accent (signal amber #f59e0b), held to a tiny footprint and always semantic; danger red appears only on form errors, always with an icon.
Cabinet Grotesk for the few display statements; IBM Plex Mono for everything else, body and metadata alike.
Sharp corners everywhere (0px radius) and a white-fill primary button that warms to amber on hover.
Work presented as logbook rows, not cards, with no numeric indices; each section opens with an instrument-badge eyebrow.
Motion is restraint plus a deferred WebGL node-network behind the hero on capable desktop; everything collapses cleanly under reduced-motion and the static hero is the universal baseline.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: The amber accent (#f59e0b) appears on no more than ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point: it is a signal, not a theme. If a second thing wants to be amber, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The True-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never #000 and never #fff. The darkest surface is #0a0a0a and the lightest text is #f5f5f5, and every neutral is untinted graphite. Pure black or white reads as unfinished here.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Partner Rule
rules.body: Amber and danger never carry meaning alone. Wherever a color signals (link, status, focus, a form error), a non-color partner travels with it (position, an icon, a weight shift, the leading square marker) so the meaning survives for color-blind readers.

rules.name: The Mono-Everything Rule
rules.body: Only the few display-scale anchor statements are Cabinet Grotesk; all prose and all metadata are IBM Plex Mono. A sentence and a date share one machine-readable voice, which is the logbook conceit.

rules.name: The Sparse-Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is rationed: at most one or two display-scale statements per view, surrounded by quiet. Its size is the emphasis; do not dilute it by setting ordinary copy large.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is forbidden as a depth device. If something needs to read as elevated, step its background up one tonal surface and give it a hairline border.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn in 1px borders (#262626, or #404040 for controls) and never thicker as a decorative device. No 2px+ colored side-stripes.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Don't reach for a card or modal by reflex. Work goes in bordered logbook rows; prefer inline progressive patterns over modals.

dos: Do keep amber (#f59e0b) under ~10% of any screen and always semantic (link, marker, status, focus, active).
Do build depth with true-neutral tonal surfaces (#0a0a0a to #0d0d0d to #171717 to #1f1f1f) and 1px hairlines (#262626 / #404040).
Do set all text, prose and metadata alike, in IBM Plex Mono, reserving Cabinet Grotesk for the one or two display statements per view.
Do keep every corner sharp (0px radius) and make the primary button a white fill that warms to amber on hover.
Do open every block with the instrument-badge eyebrow (hairline box plus a 6px amber square marker), the hero kicker included.
Do pair every amber or danger signal with a non-color cue (icon, position, weight, the leading square), and give every interactive element a designed hover plus the 2px amber focus ring.
Do hold the whole site to WCAG 2.2 AA, including contrast on the small mono metadata, and collapse all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't ship the generic developer-portfolio template: no animated skill bars, no uniform grid of identical project cards, no decorative gradient blob. Work goes in logbook rows.
Don't drift toward the corporate SaaS landing page: no cream or pastel backgrounds, no soft rounded cards, no gentle gradients, no big-number hero-metric template.
Don't use box-shadow as a depth device; step a tonal surface and add a hairline instead.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff; the true-neutral graphite floor (#0a0a0a) and ceiling (#f5f5f5) are the limits.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text, or any decorative gradient. Emphasis comes from scale and weight.
Don't introduce a second accent color or a third type family. One amber, one display face (Cabinet Grotesk), one mono (IBM Plex Mono).
Don't use a colored side-stripe (border-left/border-right greater than 1px) as an accent on any element. Hairlines are full and uniform.
Don't reach for a card or a modal by reflex. Prefer the bordered logbook row and the inline progressive pattern.
